# Day 3 team notes

Optional prompts for the same shared notebook or notes file. Aim for at most
one page plus links. See the
[worksheet](../race_practical.md#submission-and-closing-discussion) and
[shared conventions](../practical_workflow.md).

Team, code/settings and course: _names, checked configuration IDs, survey/calibration source_
Reproduce: _commands and links to saved course, settings and telemetry_

## How it went

- How we surveyed the gates and checked the result; label any supplied geometry:
- Our strategy and why we chose it:
- One flown-versus-planned plot, or a labelled simulation/replay if we did not fly:
- The outcome, one failure or uncertainty, and what we would change next:

Keep the preflight record and shared attempt log separately: operators, battery
condition, configuration/course, official time/penalty, validity, telemetry and
observer links, and any abort reason. Include failed starts. A team recorder can
maintain this log; there is no need to duplicate it in the notes.

Compare estimated tracking with independently observed crossings and official
times. A fast lap, a small in-loop residual and an accurate physical trajectory
are different claims.
